answer: Make every identity pay rent in work it cannot share. Each epoch, an agent must solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle seeded by that epoch's randomness before its votes or outputs count. One honest agent barely notices the cost, but a farm of a thousand fakes must buy a thousand times the RAM and time, every epoch, forever. The old fable that copies are free collapses: at the zenith of an attack the operator's bill grows like a plume of smoke, while rewards per fake stay flat.
